scope: seven new reference cases and unified read-only invocation of the three accepted pilots
case_dispatch: explicit case IDs; no implicit SRAM/RRAM array default
clock_policy: target 5ns; modeled complete path bound; otherwise upward 0.5ns grid; explicit legal fixed points permitted
new_case_path_window: one complete clock period for every modeled path; PCM/GC retain two scheduled service ticks but receive no pilot multicycle exception
clock_scope: native frontend and opaque program/erase/restore do not set the public digital clock; explicitly retained NAND arithmetic budgets are charged but unvalidated
template_semantics: ordered serial operations; only digital consumers or explicit capture boundaries align; repeated templates are compressed only after stationary ordered-body timing is verified
template_verification: expanded execution compared against compressed latency, counts, physical time and boundary waits for every reference service
type_context: new cases use no SubArray; mandatory MemCell context is not storage identity; executed DFF/Adder/SarADC files audited for field reads
native_service_policy: complete original operation boundaries retained without subtracting guessed peripherals; external readiness capture is separately declared
missing_aggregate_write: null with status and reason; sourced complete native operations plus public control may yield a valid hybrid resident total
payload: B_S=K*bytes_per_input; B_R=K*N*bytes_per_weight; internal encoding/copies/reference pages/maintenance add zero workload Byte
maintenance: recompute refresh read/decode/load/program occupancy and max nonpreemptive quantum; feasibility requires busy+guard<period; infeasible effective metrics are null without clipping
latency_vs_capacity: raw physical service latency is distinct from availability-adjusted long-term cost; arrival-dependent maintenance waiting is not asserted as raw/availability
metrics: rho and tau use one configuration, clock and maintenance policy; RI=rho/tau and U=(N*bytes_per_weight/bytes_per_input)*RI
numerical_scope: finite digital graph arithmetic and source-grounded nominal ACIM diagnostics are separate from analog accuracy; no synthetic transfer fitted to make vectors pass
historical_policy: pilots, Step2 inputs, historical accepted results, native NVM, TableII, paper and locked upstream worktrees unchanged
